title: Real-Time Environmental TEM Investigation of Perovskite Electrode Degradation in Solid Oxide Cells
content: Understanding real-time degradation mechanisms at the nanoscale is crucial for enhancing the performance and durability of solid oxide electrolyzers and fuel cells (SOEC/SOFC) components. While conventional post-mortem techniques provide valuable structural insights, they fail to capture the dynamic processes occurring under operational conditions. In this work, we leverage the capabilities of operando environmental transmission electron microscopy (ETEM) to directly visualize and analyze interface degradation in perovskite-based electrodes at the atomic scale.
